verdict.rationale: Opting out of vendor telemetry is a fair question for an error-monitoring SaaS with SDKs and an MCP server, so the axis applies. The pack has no documented opt-out from Rollbar's own usage tracking. The "telemetry" items (breadcrumb timeline, AUL log capture) describe data Rollbar collects about the customer's app, not an opt-out, and data-retention settings are an adjacent control that earns no credit.
